subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Faithful
solution:
The correct answer is: Devoted

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Faithful **means loyal, consistent, and committed. (वफादार, सुसंगत और प्रतिबद्ध)

 
 
• **For example- ***The dog remained faithful to its owner throughout their years together.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Devoted **means Showing strong love, loyalty, or dedication towards someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के प्रति गहरा प्रेम, निष्ठा या समर्पण दिखाना)
 
 
• **For example- ***She is a devoted friend who is always there to offer support.*
 
 
 
• From here it is clear that 'devoted' is the most appropriate **synonym **for the given word 'faithful'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wavering **means uncertain or hesitant. It is the opposite of faithful. (अनिश्चित या झिझक वाला)
 
• **Untrustworthy **means not reliable or dependable. It is the opposite of faithful. (विश्वसनीय या भरोसेमंद नहीं)
 
• **Fickle **means changing frequently, especially in regard to one's loyalty or affection. It is the opposite of faithful. (बार-बार बदलना, विशेषकर किसी की वफादारी या स्नेह के संबंध में)
